amendment_reason: Signal-blind metadata-only amendment after R2 completed and the first R3 attempt blocked before reading SAR radiometric values because the full-scene R2 rasters had different extents. The archived metadata audit proved the products share the same unrotated EPSG:32718 10 m target-pixel lattice with an exact integer-pixel origin phase. R3 may therefore use exact native-pixel co-windows on that common lattice without resampling. No R3 validity/support pixels, R4 change metric, outcome field, case/control role, threshold, date, pair, basin, or radiometric value was inspected or changed to motivate this amendment.
purpose: Pre-register zero-resampling common spatial support construction before any Cashahuacra Sentinel-1 pre/post difference or change metric is computed.

target_pixel_lattice_gate.origin_phase_rule: Differences in target-grid origins divided by the corresponding pixel vector must be exact integers within tolerance.
target_pixel_lattice_gate.scientific_rationale: A common integer-pixel lattice permits exact native-pixel intersection despite different full-scene extents; it is not a post-hoc resampling operation.

basin_window_preservation.rule: Derive the smallest integer window on the frozen pre R2 target lattice whose extent covers the frozen basin geometry. Map exactly those geospatial bounds to the post R2 raster and require an integer native-pixel window with identical output affine transform and shape. Read each native source window directly and write without resampling or radiometric transformation.

basin_pixelization.rule: Rasterize the frozen basin geometry once on the common frozen target-grid co-window using pixel-center semantics.
basin_pixelization.denominator: all common-target-grid pixel centers inside the frozen basin polygon

per_date_validity.rule: A basin pixel is valid for a date only when the raster dataset mask is valid, the Gamma0 value is finite, and the linear Gamma0 value is strictly greater than zero.

common_support.definition: basin_mask AND pre_valid_mask AND post_valid_mask on the exact zero-resampling common target-pixel co-window

allowed_outputs: full-scene grid metadata and target-lattice identity audit
deterministic common geospatial basin bounds and separate native source row/column windows
identical output co-window affine transform and dimensions
lossless pre and post basin-window GeoTIFFs and SHA-256
pre valid pixel count and fraction
post valid pixel count and fraction
common valid pixel count and fraction
binary common-support mask GeoTIFF and SHA-256
